units.title: AS9102 Form 1/2/3 auto-author + balloon-from-GDT

units.title: Fixture authoring engine (soft-jaw + tombstone)
units.scope: Soft-jaw machining program generation + tombstone layout optimizer + vise-stop selection from part geometry. ME hand-edit replaced where geometry is regular.

units.title: DFM gate at MS7 stage 0 (before feature-to-strategy commitment)
units.scope: Wire dfm_check + dfm_analyze actions before FeatureToStrategyEngine; fire DFM violations at print intake; ME pushes back at quote time, not after toolpath generation.

units.title: GD&T → datum-strategy graph (consumed by MS15 WCS chain)
units.scope: Position 0.025 to A-B drives toolpath sequence (datum-feature-first machining), probe routine selection, operation grouping (single-setup for related datums). Inter-machine WCS chain (PPG-MS15/U-PPGM91) consumes this graph.

units.title: Setup sheet AS9100 traceability fields + e-signature
units.scope: Extend MS13 setup sheet with rev-controlled signoff, tool calibration cert linkage, material heat-lot, operator certification check, electronic signature audit trail. Already partially in PPG-MS20/U-PPGM120 — this unit specifies setup-sheet UI.
